purpose: Authoritative Rust delivery-bundle progress and explicit mapping to the unchanged acceptance catalogue. Legacy Next acceptance evidence is not Rust migration proof.
policy: Model-neutral lead coordinates capacity-limited agents on codex/rust-backend-migration. Native implementation, actual consumer wiring, per-packet legacy retirement and targeted checks are separate from strict catalogue certification. One central coordinator owns claims/shared integration/direct non-force pushes. Full acceptance, containers and production preparation follow migration; preserve evidence and external WIP.

catalogue.interpretation: The 206 items are catalogue workflows, not the number of bounded flows. Each listed ID occurs once below. A partial item has supporting qualified slices, not whole-workflow verification.

evidencePolicy.statusMeaning: partial, verified and merged are independent booleans; verified requires the entire original catalogue scope to meet the Rust, frontend, legacy-retirement and gate requirements; merged requires that fully verified workflow to be integrated and pushed to the target branch.
evidencePolicy.currentState: Support source-record/navigation is qualified as first-bundle blocker evidence, not an additional business flow or whole catalogue workflow.
evidencePolicy.evidenceLocation: Source identities and bounded scope are recorded below and in the existing ignored execution state; preserve historical evidence and cite existing contracts when directly recorded.
evidencePolicy.noDoubleCount: Flows may support several catalogue items and multiple flows may support one item; no flow adds to the 206 denominator.
evidencePolicy.retirementGate: A migrated capability is not closed until its replaced routes, services, commands, jobs, selectors/fallbacks, imports/exports/configuration, obsolete tests and unused dependencies are removed, with behavioral assertions preserved. Shared retained parts need actual consumers/scope/removal conditions. No destructive schema/data/history/evidence cleanup.
evidencePolicy.containerOrder: Complete Rust, frontend/dependencies, legacy withdrawal and local gates across the migration first. Docker and Dev Container preparation follow the entire goal; do not substitute a TS backend.
evidencePolicy.milestoneSeparation: Report source-mapped workflow and owner status, retained legacy consumers and removal conditions, checks, blockers and verified pushed SHA separately. Docker and production preparation are deferred until after this goal.
preRemovalGate: API, internal callers, jobs and retries use the Rust owner in the declared scope.
Frontend uses Rust and the actual normal-authentication journey passes.
Authorization, transactions, idempotency, audit/outbox and error behavior pass.
Reference and consumer inventory establishes no required user of the replaced implementation.
evidencePolicy.removalTiming: Remove replaced implementation in the validated capability batch or its immediate dependent cleanup before counting it closed; preserve behavior assertions and do not accumulate cleanup until the final migration.
evidencePolicy.postRemovalGate: Verify targeted regressions, remaining references, dependency boundaries and runtime ownership on the latest post-removal candidate. Source deletion invalidates affected evidence only; unrelated source-matched evidence is reused.
evidencePolicy.protectedHistory: Implementation removal never authorizes dropping tables, data, audit, migration history, receipts or prior evidence.

ownershipBoundaries.field: Field owns its orders, Agreements, events and domain policies. Existing native shared POST branches remain independently opted in; all retained branches and other consumers must be accounted for before old writer withdrawal.

ownershipBoundaries.finance: Finance owns costs, journal posting, invoice/Money and prerequisite settings; source-qualified separate authority is required where the retained flow requires it.
ownershipBoundaries.support: Support owns linked ticket facts and real deferred projection; Field source linkage cannot be replaced by a label.
ownershipBoundaries.files: Files owns staging, bytes, scan, links, binding/withdrawal and events; Field owns visit authority/version and actual attachment receipt effects.
ownershipBoundaries.work_records: Work contribution and Records reads are bounded slices; atomic Records guard consumers remain same-unit until migrated and must not use remote Work IDs as proof.
ownershipBoundaries.jobs: Retained dispatcher src/workers/jobs.ts and Files scan/provider jobs remain TypeScript pending explicit owner assignment and replacement/retention proof; no native worker cutover is implied.
ownershipBoundaries.cutover: Private nonproduction flags and Next transport selectors currently opt in per Holding or record; default and production ownership are not migrated. A migrate.* packet that still records owner writers or reads binds an existing retire.<owner>* task; the coordinator records retireTaskId and fails RETIRE_TASK_REQUIRED otherwise. A packet whose own check reaches after: 0 needs no binding.

A retire.* task closes only at after: 0. Any non-zero residual is classified exactly in the check residual array with path, writes, removalTaskId and removalCondition summing to after. A recorded after may never exceed the previous after for the same command (RETIREMENT_KPI_REGRESSION).
